title: Sean Payton on CB Ja’Quan McMillian: “He’s got all the things you’re looking for”

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Sean Payton on CB Ja’Quan McMillian: “He’s got all the things you’re looking for”
sources.description: After some false rumors earlier this week about the Broncos having contract talks with cornerback Ja’Quan McMillian, many wondered where the two sides stood heading into the season. Head coach Sean Payton was asked about this on Thursday, and he made it sound like McMillian would be staying with the Broncos for the foreseeable future. […]
